# Test the /_jsonspec/schemas.json server endpoint returns the loaded bundle.

md2html -http :8182 -jsonspec-prefixes ascf/ -jsonspec-schemas schema doc.md &
sleep 1s

# Bundle is served as application/json.
curl -s -H 'Accept: application/json' http://localhost:8182/_jsonspec/schemas.json
stdout '"hypothesis"'
stdout '"strategy_tag"'
stdout '"local_search"'

# Without -jsonspec-schemas the endpoint 404s. Start a second server
# on a different port.
md2html -http :8183 doc.md &
sleep 1s
curl -s -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:8183/_jsonspec/schemas.json
stdout '404'

-- doc.md --
# Doc

```json
{"type": "ascf/hypothesis"}
```

-- schema/hypothesis.schema.json --
{
  "title": "Hypothesis",
  "required": ["type"],
  "properties": {
    "type": {"const": "ascf/hypothesis"},
    "strategy_tag": {"type": "string", "enum": ["local_search", "crossover"]}
  }
}
